lines.text: Jesus gives the Twelve power over all demons and power to cure diseases, then sends them to proclaim God's kingdom.
Jesus tells them to take nothing for the journey: no staff, no bag, no bread, no money, no second tunic.
They stay in one house until they leave that area, and call down fire on towns that reject them.

wrong_details.wrong: call down fire on towns that reject them
wrong_details.true: shake the dust off your feet

lines.text: The Twelve set out and go straight to Jerusalem, preaching the gospel and healing people everywhere.
Herod is perplexed by reports that John rose, Elijah appeared, or a prophet arose, and keeps trying to see Jesus.
